content_blocks.steps_heading: Your PMP Certification Pathway in Melbourne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and hours of hands-on project leadership. Contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course delivered by certified professionals. Earn the required formal education hours through interactive sessions covering all five process groups and knowledge areas. Upon completion, receive your Granite PM Academy certificate of completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Provide proof of your education hours and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee to activate your application and secure your exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam and receive your results upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration by submitting proof of continuing education in project management. Stay current with industry standards and advance your career trajectory in Melbourne's aerospace and defense sector.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
